## Compatibility and related changes

Link related client/backend changes and exact revisions tested together. Explain old-client support, migration/deployment order and rollback where relevant.

## Design and operating cost

For material decisions, explain cohesive responsibilities, dependency boundaries, the simplest viable alternative and adoption/operating/maintenance costs. Identify handwritten files over 300 lines that need splitting or a justified cohesive exception.

## Verification

For meaningful behavior changes, record the expected failing test and the passing result after implementation; explain proportional verification for mechanical changes. List commands and results. Separate mocks/consumer fixtures from live provider integration. State omitted scopes, unresolved failures and remaining release gates.
